as_told.title: Fast walkers: leaked Podesta–Bob Fish email

plain: An email published by Wikileaks, a website that puts out leaked documents, is said to show a man named Bob Fish writing to John Podesta, whose emails were in the leak, about "fast walkers", a term Michels ties to objects up near geostationary orbit, the high orbit where satellites hang over one spot. Michels brings this up himself on several episodes, without giving a source beyond the leak. He calls Fish an aerospace contractor who he thinks might have worked at a company called Aerospace Corporation in El Segundo, California, though once he calls him an IT contractor, and he dates the email to around 2015 or 2016. He raises it as a sign that UFO matters reached people close to the top of American politics.
